title: Project terms
description: Product names, languages, protocols and acronyms spelled the way their owners spell them.

rules.name: Spell a term the way its owner does
rules.message: "{match}" is not the canonical spelling: write "{replacement}".

examples.note: the finding replaces Github with GitHub

rules.fix: Use the canonical spelling from the terms list. Declare a variant for a spelling the project accepts.

citation.note: A term matches case-insensitively at word boundaries. Plurals and possessives need no declaration. Inline code, paths, domains and handles are never flagged.
